screen.title: Coded diagnosis statistics
screen.purpose: The hospital's morbidity and mortality by ICD chapter and code, and how completely records are coded.

rule_objects.text: Default period: this month so far (date_from / date_to to change). Tiles from `completeness`: % of OPD / emergency notes, discharges and certified deaths carrying a code (MSDS 105 vii); low coding in red.
Tables: `chapters` (code_system + chapter + title, OPD / inpatient / deaths / total) and `top_codes`; a null chapter means the code is in no loaded list.
Print or export it for the quality committee and the district's monthly return, with `citation` (the ICD-11 licence requires the attribution) at the foot.

definition_of_done.rule: Agents MUST submit propose_progress after implementing this screen and verify it with progress_proposals. Only the developer accepts items on My progress for what this implementation does on the DEV server. No tool awards progress.
